ensemble.note: SYNTHETIC geological uncertainty: a seeded lognormal multiplicative perturbation of the block values with a spatially correlated field, NOT a conditional simulation with drillhole data behind it.
ensemble.replanningNote: A lower bound on EVPI from node-bounded C-PIT[D] neighborhood searches started from the same best fixed policy. Feasible incumbents and neighborhood proof status are recorded per realization; the outer local search is heuristic, not a global two-stage optimum.

bound.monotone_note: more capacity cannot lower an LP bound and a higher discount rate cannot raise it. Measured per held-out deposit by holding everything else and sweeping one feature.
bound.split: by deposit seed, never by row

expectedTime.refuted: core_halo: 71/216 of training cases fail, 37/108 held out; layered: 59/216 of training cases fail, 26/108 held out; porphyry: 5/216 of training cases fail, 2/108 held out; vein: 138/216 of training cases fail, 80/108 held out. The failures concentrate in vein, and they do so on BOTH splits, which is what the first and much narrower sweep could not show: with five scenarios running rate and capacity together at a correlation of -0.735, the scenario looked like the cause and the orebody looked refuted.
expectedTime.split: by deposit seed, never by row
expectedTime.target_relaxation: the tightest single-resource relaxation used for exact expected-time ordering

guard.live_unavailable_reason: third-split recall 0.429 is below the required 0.8180; third-split precision 0.528 is below the required 0.6670; third-split worst_unflagged 0.732 is below the required 0.7852
guard.note: measured on a third disjoint seed set that had no part in choosing the rule. The held-out score is shown separately because it informed selection. Where the exact plan is in the same bake the product shows the MEASURED ratio. A rule that misses any release threshold is research-only and cannot flag a live plan.

learned.honesty: Neither model certifies anything. The certified bound comes from the critical multiplier algorithm or from Bienstock-Zuckerberg; these are scored against the exact quantity they approximate, on deposits they never saw, split by deposit seed.

role.en: The trust anchor. A published MineLib instance solved with its own periods, its own discount rate and its own two capacities. The 2018 comparison is a PCPSP result, while an external AMPL notebook reports a separate CPIT integer optimum.
role.es: El ancla de confianza. Una instancia publicada de MineLib resuelta con sus propios períodos, su propia tasa y sus dos capacidades. La comparación de 2018 es PCPSP; un cuaderno externo de AMPL informa por separado un óptimo entero CPIT.
